clips.title: The story
paras: Yaw Sharpmane is an experienced tauren hunter trainer stationed in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He guides young hunters venturing out from Camp Narache, helping them master the wild beasts of their ancestral plains.

Positioned amidst the tents and fires of Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane serves the Shu'halo as an instructor in the ways of marksmanship, tracking, and survival. Young hunters who have proven themselves in Red Cloud Mesa are directed to Yaw to hone their craft as they step onto the broader plains of Mulgore.

Yaw's most essential role is guiding novice hunters through the ancient rite of taming wild beasts. He tasks initiates with bonding with the native fauna of Mulgore, testing their patience and respect for the natural balance before instructing them on how to properly care for and train a permanent companion.
